name: Turn a spec into a tested service with API docs
why: Takes a written spec to a working service with API tests and an API spec, the contract-first path of the endpoint build skill.

name: First API endpoint prompt for Next.js
why: A gentle first endpoint for a founder or front-end developer who has never written server code.

name: Redis + BullMQ Job Queue coding prompt
why: Sets up a job queue with retries and failed-job handling, the queue a webhook receiver hands its work to.

name: Recoverable agent job queue builder
why: Plans a queue that survives crashes with no repeated paid work and capped retries, the same rules as safe webhook processing.

name: Agent wakeup and stale-claim builder
why: Shows duplicate checks, leases and retries for event-driven flows, useful when designing dedupe stores.

name: Agent database migration planner
why: Plans a schema change that keeps existing data, with staging checks, release order and recovery steps, like the safe migration skill.

name: Connect Code to Supabase coding prompt
why: Connects an app to Supabase with scoped access and safe secrets, a common database setup for small teams.

name: Stop fake orders, card testing and bot abuse
why: Covers fraud rules and bot limits for checkout, the business-flow side of the OWASP API6 risk.

name: Payments and checkout settings checker
why: Checks payment and checkout settings and ranks risks, a useful companion before a payment integration goes live.

name: Find leaked keys, secure them and check your live site
why: Finds leaked keys and moves secrets to safe storage, for when a live key was committed or pasted.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves the cause before fixing and ends in a small pull request, the right path for an endpoint that errors or returns wrong data.

name: Launch readiness seam checker
why: Checks the joins between parts of a release or migration and builds a run-through plan, a second look before go-live.
